parameters.name: ConnectionStringPrefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the endpoint that is used to connect to the database.

parameters.name: DisablePorts
parameters.description:
*   The database ports that you want to disable. Separate multiple ports with commas (,).

*   This parameter is supported only for clusters whose minor engine version is 24.10.1.11098\_1 or later.

    **

    **Note** If you create a cluster whose minor engine version is earlier than 24.10.1.11098\_1 and you update the minor engine version to 24.10.1.11098\_1 or later, the cluster still does not support this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun clickhouse modify-db-instance-connection-string --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id cc-xxxxx --connection-string cc-2ze340000-clickhouse..clickhouseserver.pre.rds.aliyuncs.com --connection-string-prefix cc-0000-clickhouse --disable-ports 9001,8123 --db-instance-net-type Public --computing-group-id cc-2ze340000-clickhouse --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
